output.reason: Diabetic patient with a 4-day-old plantar foot wound now showing surrounding redness, swelling and tenderness — features of a possible diabetic foot infection that need hands-on assessment today (wound inspection, probing for depth, and decisions on imaging or culture) that messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: I recommend being seen in person today — same-day clinic, urgent care or podiatry/foot service — for a diabetic foot wound with spreading redness and swelling. Someone needs to look at and probe the wound directly to judge depth and infection, which can't be done by message. A Counsel clinician can stay involved in this thread. Call 911 or go to an emergency department now if you develop fever or chills, rapidly spreading redness or red streaking, severe pain, or blackening skin.
